Title: GeometryTab scope indicator
Body: v90b removed the This/All scope picker entirely
when reducing to global-only scope. UI now has no
visible indication of "this preset applies to all
nodes." When the per-node geometry override system
lands (separately filed), the picker comes back. In
the interim, consider a single "All nodes" text label
or other minimal affordance during the next polish
pass. Affects Geometry spoke visual consistency with
Color spoke.
